dependency.requires: NEW_OR_LEGITIMATELY_CONTINUED PRODUCT_DIRECTOR_LF PROFILE RUN / IN_PROGRESS / Step70 PASS_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC / RUN PATCH RAW / screen scope

queries.purpose: Listado completo de RUN elegibles de Product Director, reglas CREATE/CANDIDATO/VIGENTE, SHA de patch RAW y source SHA equivalente para lectura

patch_card.caller_source_sha256: COMPUTE_THROUGH_OFFICIAL_AUTHORIZED_CONTEXT; SELECT-only equivalent not full writer authority

decision_record_template.frase_literal: Yo, Cristhian Luján, RECHAZO la propuesta de la regla <RULE_CODE_FROM_VERIFIED_RUN>, SHA-256 <EXACT_SHA256_FROM_GOVERNED_RULE_PATCH_RAW>, originada en el RUN <EXECUTION_ID_REAL>; no autorizo ejecución ni promoción.

operational_controls: Do not reuse an old/COMPLETED RUN; parent must be IN_PROGRESS and Product Director with valid handoff and screen.
Check actual execute_profile RAW worker/product_decision/independent judge and proposal SHA in live record, never merely documentary L32 sha.
Re-read source canonical SNAPSHOT via officially authorized context because direct SELECT of lf_asset_snapshot_sha_v1 returns 42501.
Check exact six strings, veredicto=RECHAZAR and actual owner literal phrase, date within parent.start-5min and now+5min at call time.
Do not call until owner separately authorizes writer dispatch. RECHAZAR writes immutable record but no rule update or promotion.
If a rule has already been rejected for parent+code+kind, no overwrite; use a new legitimate RUN for later approval.

risk_owner_acceptance_required.risk: Permanent recorded RECHAZAR for one RUN+rule+kind, no overwrite
risk_owner_acceptance_required.owner_action: Actual literal rejection with rule/code/SHA/RUN and separate explicit dispatch authorization
Documentary owner acceptance for temporary test only; IAM team required for production

risk_no_owner_approval_required.risk: Running SELECT-only detector and hash audit
Running lab tests and negative smoke against isolated PG

rollback.reject: No rule mutation; decision receipt append-only and cannot be silently removed, future approval needs new RUN.
rollback.approve: Potential rule VIGENTE; atomic rollback only if function transaction raises; after COMMIT requires separately governed compensating change; not recommended first.
